questions.q: Her father insists that she ____ abroad.
questions.zh: 她的父親堅持要她出國。
questions.explain:
insist 是表示「堅持」的動詞。其句型：
主詞 + insist (that) + 主詞 + (should) + 原形 V

questions.q: The doctor suggested that the patient ____ smoking.
questions.zh: 醫生建議這病人該戒菸。
questions.explain:
suggest 是表示「建議」的動詞。其句型：
主詞 + suggest (that) + 主詞 + (should) + 原形 V

questions.q: Our teacher asked that right ____ distinguished from wrong.
questions.zh: 我們的老師要求分辨是非。
questions.explain: 主詞 + ask + that + 主詞 + (should) + 原形 V；本句為被動語態，故用原形 be distinguished。

questions.q: I recommend that the student ____ to the director.
questions.zh: 我建議這學生去向他的指導老師說。
questions.explain: recommend 是表示「建議」的動詞，其後的 that 子句中的 should 可省略，動詞一律用原形動詞。

questions.q: Is it necessary that he ____ the examination?
questions.zh: 他有必要參加考試嗎？
questions.explain: It is necessary that + S + (should) + 原形 V。

questions.q: If he works hard, he ____ in the end.
questions.zh: 如果他努力工作，他最後將成功。
questions.explain:
本題表示「條件」之副詞子句（直述法條件句）：
If + S + V（現在式）, S + will/shall + V（未來式）。

questions.q: If I ____ you, I would go to the party with her.
questions.zh: 如果我是你，我會和她一起去參加宴會。
questions.explain: 主句為 would + 原形 V，表示「與現在事實相反之假設」；if 子句中，be 動詞不論人稱一律用過去式 were，不可用 was。

questions.q: If it had not rained so hard yesterday, we ____ to Tianjin.
questions.zh: 如果昨天沒有下那麼大的雨，我們就去天津了。
questions.explain: 與過去事實相反的假設，主句用助動詞過去式 + have + p.p.（should have gone）。

questions.q: I would not change my mind if the sun ____ in the west tomorrow morning.
questions.zh: 即使明天太陽從西邊出來，我也不會改變主意。
questions.explain:
表示「未來絕對不可能發生之假設」，其句型為：
If + 主詞 + were to + 原形 V, S + would + 原形 V。

questions.q: If he ____ to the gate last night, I would have given him this letter.
questions.zh: 如果他昨晚來到大門口，我會把信拿給他。
questions.explain: 與過去事實相反的假設，條件子句動詞用 had + p.p.（had come）。

questions.q: Had you told him the truth, he ____ some suggestions.
questions.zh: 如果你告訴他實話，他可能會提些建議。
questions.explain: Had you told... = If you had told... 表示與過去事實相反之假設，主句用 would/should/might + have + p.p.。

questions.q: ____ him, I would have spoken to him.
questions.zh: 如果我當時認識他，我會和他談談。
questions.explain: If I had known him,... = Had I known him,...，與過去事實相反的假設，if 省略時形成倒裝。

questions.q: ____ here yesterday, you would have seen the charming girl.
questions.zh: 假如昨天你在這裡，你就會看到這個迷人的女孩。
questions.explain: 原句 = If you had been here yesterday,...，省略 if 倒裝為 Had you been...。

questions.q: ____ it rained last night, the ground would be wet now.
questions.zh: 昨晚若是下雨，現在地上一定會溼溼的。
questions.explain: Had it rained ~ = If it had rained ~，條件子句與過去相反（had + p.p. 倒裝），主句與現在相反（would be ... now），為混和時態。

questions.q: The machine can pull up trees as if they ____ weeds.
questions.zh: 這部機器拔樹就像在拔草一樣。
questions.explain: as if 表示與現在事實相反的假設，be 動詞一律用 were。

questions.q: ____ I not so busy right now, I would do it.
questions.zh: 若我不是這麼忙，我會做那件事。
questions.explain: 原句 = If I were not so busy,...，省略 if 倒裝為 Were I not...。

questions.q: ____ your help, I would have been drowned.
questions.zh: 若非你幫忙，我那時就淹死了。
questions.explain: Without = But for + N（若非；要不是），接名詞片語表示與過去事實相反之假設。

questions.q: He would have made the speech only that he ____ a sore throat.
questions.zh: 若非他（當時）喉嚨痛，他會發表演說。
questions.explain: Only that / But that + S + 過去簡單式, S + 過去式助動詞 + have + p.p.。that 子句敘述過去的事實，故動詞用過去簡單式 had。

questions.q: It's eleven already. It's time ____ home.
questions.zh: 已經是十一點了，該是回家的時候了。
questions.explain: It's (about/high) time (that) S + 過去簡單式 V（該是……時候了）。

questions.q: If the earth stopped moving, what ____?
options: do you think would be happened
did you think will be happened
questions.zh: 如果地球停止轉動，你想會發生什麼事？
questions.explain:
① 表示「與現在事實相反」的主句其句型為「主詞 + would + 原形 V」。
② happen 表示「事情的發生」，為不及物動詞，無被動式。
③ do you think 為插入句，與句子的時態無關。

questions.q: If you ____ with George yesterday morning, you would not be so angry now.
questions.zh: 如果昨天早上你和 George 談過話，你現在就不會生氣了。
questions.explain: 條件子句裡有 yesterday morning，表示「過去」，故動詞用 had + p.p.（had talked）；主句有 now，動詞用 would not be，為混和時態。

questions.q: One of the boys made the suggestion that he ____ to the lake alone.
questions.zh: 男孩中有一個建議說他應該一個人去湖邊。
questions.explain: S + made the suggestion (= suggested) that + S + (should) + 原形 V。

questions.q: That was a close call; you ____ hit by the car.
questions.zh: 真是千鈞一髮！你差點就被車子撞倒。
questions.explain: 本題的條件部分（If...）被省略掉，表示過去差一點發生的危險，用 could have been hit。

questions.q: ____ to participate, I might have won the grand prize.
questions.zh: 如果我有機會參加，我可能會獲得這項大獎。
questions.explain: If I had had the chance,... = Had I had the chance,...，省略 if 形成倒裝。

questions.q: Had I driven a little slower, I ____ you.
options: could not have missed to see
questions.zh: 我若開慢點，就不會錯過而看不到你。
questions.explain:
① 此題考「與過去事實相反的假設」，主句用 could not have + p.p.。
② miss（錯過）其後須接動名詞 V-ing 或名詞 N，故用 missed seeing。

questions.q: "I guess so." Mother replied. "But I still wish they ____ good, steady jobs."
questions.zh: 「我也是這樣認為。」母親回答說：「但我仍然希望他們有好的固定工作。」
questions.explain: S + wish that + S + 過去簡單式 V，表示「與現在事實相反之假設」。

questions.q: The quarrel between my neighbors is becoming serious. It's time I took a hand in it and ____ to stop it.
questions.zh: 我鄰居間的爭執愈來愈嚴重了。該是我插手設法阻止的時候了。
questions.explain: It's time that + S + 過去簡單式 V。and 對等連接 took a hand 與 tried，動詞時態必須一致。

questions.q: We wish that you ____ such a lot of work to do, because we know that you would have enjoyed the party.
questions.zh: 我們但願你那時沒有這麼多工作要做，因為我們知道你會喜歡那個宴會的。
questions.explain: S + wish that + S + had + p.p.（過去完成式），表示「與過去事實相反之假設」，因句子後有 would have enjoyed...

questions.q: I have often come across people doing jobs that I have never dreamed of before, and which would ____ me had I been told about them at school.
questions.zh: 我經常碰到一些人做我以前從未夢想過的事，這些事若在我唸書時有人告訴我，那可會令我激動不已。
questions.explain: 此題考「與過去事實相反的假設」。本題後半句原為：If I had been told about them at school, they would have thrilled me. 省略 if 倒裝為 had I been told...，主句動詞用 would have thrilled。

questions.q: I am sitting on the riverbank, feeling very unhappy. My wet clothes are in a heap next to me. I'm wrapped in Dad's warm, dry blanket. But I feel damp. I wish I ____ fishing today.
questions.zh: 我現在正坐在河堤上，覺得很不快樂。我的溼衣服堆放在一旁，我全身裹在父親溫暖的乾毯子內，但還是覺得溼溼的。要是今天我沒釣魚就好了！
questions.explain: S + wish that + S + 過去式動詞，表示「與現在事實相反之假設」句，因本句中有 today 出現。

sections.title: （三）翻譯填充題
sections.instructions: 根據中文提示，在空格處填入最適當的單字或片語以完成英文句子

questions.q:
該是提高我們教育水準的時候了。
It is ____ that we raised the level of our ____.
questions.zh: 該是提高我們教育水準的時候了。
questions.explain:
「該是……時候了」：
It is time / It is high time / It is about time that + S + V-ed（過去簡單式）
education 為「教育」。

questions.q:
如果你沒有成功，你應該再試一次。
If you don't succeed, you ____ ____.
questions.zh: 如果你沒有成功，你應該再試一次。
questions.explain: 條件子句為直述法現在式，主句用助動詞 should + 原形動詞 try again。

questions.q:
如果方便的話，今晚打電話給我。
If (it is) ____, ____ me ____ tonight.
questions.zh: 如果方便的話，今晚打電話給我。
questions.explain:
it is 在下列情況下常省略：
if (it is) necessary（必要的話）、if (it is) possible（可能的話）、if (it is) needed（需要的話）、if (it is) convenient（方便的話）。
call up 為「打電話給……」。

questions.q:
若不是他的鼓勵，我決不再試了。
____ ____ his encouragement, I would not ____ any more attempt.
questions.zh: 若不是他的鼓勵，我決不再試了。
questions.explain:
But for / Without + N, S + would / could (not) / should + 原形 V（若非；要不是；若無），表示「與現在事實相反之假設」。
make an attempt 為固定片語搭配。

questions.q:
如果我已經知道了他的住址，我早就告訴你了。
If I ____ ____ his address, I ____ ____ ____ you.
questions.zh: 如果我已經知道了他的住址，我早就告訴你了。
questions.explain: If + S + had + p.p. ..., S + would / could (not) / should + have + p.p.，表示「與過去事實相反之假設」。

sections.title: （四）連貫式翻譯
sections.instructions: 請根據各題中文與提示，翻譯成完整通順的英文句子

questions.q: 如果我再當高中生的話，我一定會用功讀書。
questions.hint: 高中生: a senior high school student
questions.answer: If I were a senior high school student, I would study hard.
questions.zh: 如果我再當高中生的話，我一定會用功讀書。
questions.explain: 與現在事實相反之假設：If + S + were ..., S + would + 原形 V。

questions.q: 我不會再整天玩樂，沉迷於玩電子遊戲。
questions.hint: 沉迷於: indulge oneself in；玩樂: fool around
questions.answer: I wouldn't fool around all day, indulging myself in playing video games.
questions.zh: 我不會再整天玩樂，沉迷於玩電子遊戲。
questions.explain: 本句承接上句的假設，主句延續 wouldn't + 原形 V，後接現在分詞構句 indulging myself in playing video games。

questions.q: 我不會再亂花錢，宛如自己是百萬富翁一般。
questions.answer: I wouldn't spend money lavishly as if I were a millionaire.
questions.zh: 我不會再亂花錢，宛如自己是百萬富翁一般。
questions.explain: as if + S + were... 表示與現在事實相反的假設（宛如……一般）。

questions.q: 我現在很後悔當年浪費許多寶貴的光陰。
questions.answer: I regret having wasted a lot of precious time at that time.
questions.zh: 我現在很後悔當年浪費許多寶貴的光陰。
questions.explain: regret having + p.p. 表示後悔做過某事（直述法現在式）。

questions.q: 假如那時我用心讀書，現在就是大學生了。
questions.hint: 那時: then；大學生: a college student
questions.answer: If I had studied hard then, I would be a college student now.
questions.zh: 假如那時我用心讀書，現在就是大學生了。
questions.explain: 混和時態假設：條件子句與過去事實相反（If I had studied hard then），主句與現在事實相反（I would be a college student now）。

sections.title: （五）選答案測驗
sections.instructions:
閱讀下列短文，選出最適當的答案：

I who am blind can give one hint to those __1.__: Use your eyes as if tomorrow you __2.__ blind. And the same method can __3.__ the other senses. __4.__ the music of voices, the song of a bird, the mighty strains of an __5.__, as if you __6.__ stricken deaf tomorrow. Touch each object __7.__ tomorrow your tactile sense would fail. Smell the __8.__ of flowers, taste __9.__ relish each morsel, as if tomorrow you could never __10.__ again.

【詞彙及片語提示】
1. blind [blaɪnd] (adj.) 瞎的
2. hint (n.) 暗示；指示
3. apply to（應用）；apply for（申請）
4. the other senses（其他的感官）
5. mighty strains（宏偉的樂章）
6. strike-struck-stricken（打擊）
7. object (n.) 物體；東西
8. tactile sense（觸覺）
9. relish ['relɪʃ] (n.) 美味；特別風味
10. morsel ['mɔːsəl] (n.) 小塊；一小片

questions.q: I who am blind can give one hint to those ____:
questions.zh: 我這個盲人能給那些明眼人一個忠告：
questions.explain: those who see（明眼人；看得見東西的人），those who + V 為固定代名詞結構。

questions.q: Use your eyes as if tomorrow you ____ blind.
questions.zh: 善用你的雙眼，宛如明天你就會失明。
questions.explain: as if + S + 過去式助動詞 + 原形 V，表示「與現在或未來事實相反之假設」。be stricken blind 為「突然失明」，主動形式不合，故選 would be stricken。

questions.q: And the same method can ____ the other senses.
questions.zh: 同樣的方法也能應用在其他感官上。
questions.explain: be applied to（被應用在……）；主詞 the same method 應配合被動語態。

questions.q: ____ the music of voices, the song of a bird, the mighty strains of an orchestra...
questions.zh: 去聆聽話語的樂音、鳥兒的歌唱、管弦樂團的壯麗旋律……
questions.explain: 本句為「祈使句」，主詞 You 省略，句首動詞一律用原形動詞 Hear。

questions.q: ...the mighty strains of an ____, as if you would be stricken deaf tomorrow.
questions.zh: ……管弦樂團的壯麗旋律，宛如你明天就會耳聾一般。
questions.explain:
① (A) 音樂家 (B) 樂團、管弦樂團 (C) 交響樂 (D) 作曲家。
② an 後接母音字首開頭之單字，故選 (B) orchestra。

questions.q: ...as if you ____ stricken deaf tomorrow.
questions.zh: ……宛如你明天就會失聰。
questions.explain:
① as if + S + 過去式助動詞 + 原形 V（好像；宛如），表示假設。
② would be stricken deaf（突然聾了）。

questions.q: Touch each object ____ tomorrow your tactile sense would fail.
questions.zh: 去觸摸每件物體，宛如明天你的觸覺就會失靈。
questions.explain:
① (A) 好像 (B) 以便 (C) 即使 (D) 在……地方。
② 句子後面有 would fail，應用假設句型 as if 才合文意。

questions.q: Smell the ____ of flowers, taste with relish each morsel...
questions.zh: 去嗅聞花朵的芬芳，津津有味地品嚐每一小口食物……
questions.explain: perfume 在此作名詞「香氣、芬芳」解。(A) 花、開花；(C) 滋味、風味（通常指食物味覺）；(D) 芳香的（形容詞，不能接在 the 之後作受詞）。故選 (B)。

questions.q: ...taste ____ relish each morsel, as if tomorrow you could never smell and taste again.
questions.zh: ……津津有味地品嚐每一小口食物……
questions.explain: with relish = with pleasure（津津有味地），為固定介系詞片語。

questions.q: ...as if tomorrow you could never ____ again.
questions.zh: ……宛如明天你再也無法嗅聞與品嚐。
questions.explain: 本句承接前文提及的兩種感覺「Smell」與「taste」，故選 (C) smell and taste。
